dedupe_keys.name: austrian municipal stock time series and population employment inputs

description: This deposit supplements the Austrian annual material-stock, population and employment maps with municipal summaries and input statistics. Humboldt University Berlin, BOKU Vienna and collaborating universities provide aggregated 1985–2018 series within 2018 municipality boundaries, Austrian municipality Shapefiles and annual state-level population and employment inputs derived from Statistik Austria. Zenodo lists a roughly forty-five-megabyte ZIP, with accompanying text documentation, free under CC BY 4.0. The deposit includes only map layers used in the article’s illustrations, so it is not a complete tabular replacement for the companion raster collection. Fixed boundary definitions and model-derived stock values are additional limitations for local historical comparisons. Modellers could calibrate municipal stock-flow simulations or compare population and employment assumptions. data-material-stock-maps-10m-buildings-infrastructure supplies a related snapshot baseline, while model-odym is a related modelling tool. The exact table encodings inside the archive remain unchecked. No archive or administrative-boundary file was downloaded.
